scope: camera trajectory versus independent motion capture; no surface-geometry ground truth

association.policy: both interpolation endpoints must be within tolerance; no extrapolation

coordinates.expected_pose_formula: Tinit * C * inverse(TUM0) * TUMi * C (translation converted to mm)
coordinates.angle_calculation: nearest proper rotation of saved float estimate; input orthogonality error <=0.001

initial_anchored.fit: none; first ground-truth pose defines origin and orientation

stationary_baseline.definition: hold the historical initialized camera pose for every frame

se3_aligned_position_ate.scope: position-only ATE after fitted SE(3), separate from initial-anchored errors
se3_aligned_position_ate.qualification: Low-rank motion does not constrain the full fitted rotation.
